statement: The invoice record shows it was already paid in full on 3 September (reference PAY-2291), so paying it again would result in a duplicate payment of USD 148,300; this is not safe to pay.
judge_text:
WRONG

"already paid in full on 3 September... paying it again would result in a duplicate payment" — asserts the payment action is wrong and names the specific conflict.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
